prov.heading: Allowance for credit losses on loans:
prov.text:
As of September 30, 2026, the Company utilized the Baseline scenario model of Moody’s economic scenarios and considered the uncertainty associated with the assumptions in the Baseline scenario, including continued actions taken by the Federal Reserve with regard to monetary policy and interest rates and the potential impact of those actions and the potential impact of persistent high inflation on the economy. Outcomes in any or all of these factors could differ from the Baseline scenario utilized, and the Company incorporated qualitative considerations reflecting the risk of uncertain economic conditions, and for additional dimensions of risk that may not be captured in the quantitative model.

The Company also continues to apply a reasonable and supportable forecast based on Moody’s Baseline Scenario for a four-quarter period. Following the forecast period, the model uses a four-quarter straight-line reversion to historical averages.

Qualitative adjustments continue to be evaluated using a weighted scorecard framework based on regulatory interagency guidance. The framework considers internal and external factors that may not be fully captured in the quantitative model, including changes in portfolio risk characteristics, economic conditions, lending practices, and other factors affecting the credit quality of each portfolio segment.

nonint.heading: Noninterest Expenses
nonint.text:
Total noninterest expenses were $28.0 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared to $26.2 million for the same period in 2025 . Significant changes included a $368 thousand increase in equipment expense, a $173 thousand increase in professional fees, a $308 thousand increase in outsourced services, a $178 thousand increase in advertising expense and a $613 increase in other expenses. Full time equivalent headcount was 738 as of September 30, 2025, 743 as of December 31, 2025, and 740 as of September 30, 2026. Changes in headcount represent normal fluctuations.

Total noninterest expenses were $83.3 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $78.8 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 . Significant changes included an increase of $1.5 million in salaries and employee benefits, an increase of $610 thousand in equipment expense, an increase of $552 thousand in outsourced services, an increase of $493 thousand in advertising expense and an increase of $1.8 million in other expense, partially offset by a decrease of $408 thousand in other real estate expense, net.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text: In the third quarter of 2026, TrustCo recognized income tax expense of $5.7 million compared to $5.1 million for the third quarter of 2025. The effective tax rates were 24.7% and 23.7% for the third quarters of 2026 and 2025, respectively. For the first nine months, income taxes were $16.6 million and $14.2 million in 2026 and 2025, respectively. The effective tax rate was 24.7% and 23.7% for 2026 and 2025, respectively.

net.text: TrustCo recorded net income of $17.3 million, or $1.02 of diluted earnings per share, for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to net income of $16.3 million, or $0.86 of diluted earnings per share, in the same period in 2025. Return on average assets was 1.05% and 1.02%, respectively, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025. Return on average equity was 10.57% and 9.29%, respectively, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025.

Net interest income.heading: Net Interest Income
Net interest income.text:
Net interest income increased by $3.9 million to $47.0 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. The net interest spread was up 21 basis points to 2.56% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. As previously noted, the net interest margin was also up 16 basis points to 2.95% for the third quarter of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. Yields on earning assets increased in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025, and rates on interest-bearing liabilities decreased causing margin expansion. The loan and investment portfolios continue to reprice upward as lower yielding assets mature and are replaced with higher rate loan originations and investment purchases, driving steady improvement in overall asset yields. The Federal Reserve’s decision regarding whether to raise, cut, or hold rates in upcoming meetings will have an effect on the Company’s timing and ability to raise or lower deposit costs which may impact margin in future quarters.

Net interest income increased by $12.1 million to $137.3 million in the first nine months of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. The net interest spread was up 21 basis points to 2.49% in the first nine months of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025.

Noninterest income.heading: Noninterest Income
Noninterest income.text:
Total noninterest income for the third quarter of 2026 was $4.8 million compared to $4.7 million in the third quarter of 2025. Financial Services income was up $92 thousand to $2.1 million in the third quarter of 2026 as compared to the year-ago period. The fair value of assets under management was $1.4 billion at September 30, 2026, $1.2 billion as of December 31, 2025, and $1.3 billion at September 30, 2025.

For the nine months ended September 30, 2026 total noninterest income was $15.6 million, up $1.1 million compared to the prior year period. The increase is primarily the result of the gain of $900 thousand recorded on the Visa Class C Common stock exchange during the nine months ended September 30, 2026.

intro.text: TrustCo Bank Corp NY is a $6.5 billion savings and loan holding company and through its subsidiary, Trustco Bank, operated 132 offices in New York, New Jersey, Vermont, Massachusetts, and Florida as of June 30, 2026. In addition, the Bank’s Wealth Management Department offers a full range of investment services, retirement planning and trust and estate administration services. The common shares of TrustCo are traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol TRST .
